page: Amazon Web Services m8gd.24xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by AWS Graviton processors. It features 96 dedicated physical cores based on the ARMv9 Neoverse-V2 architecture, operating at 2.8 GHz with a single thread per core. The system is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. Local storage is bundled, consisting of 5700 GB of NVMe SSD instance store capacity. Network connectivity is delivered via a 40 Gbps baseline bandwidth on the AWS Nitro hypervisor.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier multi-core performance, with stress-ng multi-core CPU and Geekbench multi-core scores placing in the top 10% of tested systems. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, registering top-tier results for both cached small-block reads and uncached large-block read and write operations. The instance also demonstrates top-tier capabilities in database operations, Redis SET operations, and static web serving throughput. However, single-core performance is more moderate, with stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores falling in the middle 50% range.

The hardware profile offers qualitative cost efficiency by utilizing energy-efficient ARM64 architecture combined with high-density local NVMe storage, reducing the need for external network-attached storage for high-I/O workloads. While multi-threaded tasks, software compilation, and database operations excel, workloads heavily reliant on single-threaded execution or x86-specific instruction sets may experience relative performance tradeoffs. This instance is highly suited for multi-threaded database deployments, high-throughput web serving, caching layers, and software compilation pipelines.
